title: Habitat Rotation
acceptance: Specs show the schedule is deterministic across servers (same clock → same habitat), with correct boundaries (warning at T-60, closing at T-15, swap at T-0), wrap-around, and config changes that apply without touching test settings.
A swap while a player carries keeps the carry (same species, variant and deadline). Securing after the swap adds exactly one monster.
A swap during an open meter session cancels it cleanly. No monster is created, and no claim or prompt is left behind.
A swap during an escape chase follows the approved policy. The fleeing capture is neither duplicated nor silently deleted, and the chase or loss is reported to the player.
Players still inside are handled per policy, and nobody ends up inside new geometry (scenario check).
Capture starts are refused while closing, and normal play resumes after the swap.
FullLoop, CrossPlot and ExploitProbe pass. `scripts/check.sh` passes.
